sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: 209 Glossary Glossary Abundance: A very large quantity of something.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: Accolade: An expression of praise or an acknowledgement of merit.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: Adaptation: How a living thing changes slightly over time to survive in a changing environment.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: Afterlife: A life that begins after death.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: Allotment: The giving or sharing out of something.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: Altitude: The height of an object above sea level.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: Archaeologist: A person who studies human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of physical remains.
sections.source_evidence: Archaeologist: A person who studies human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of physical remains.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: Ascetic: Someone who engages in rigorous spiritual practices to attain a higher consciousness.
sections.source_evidence: Ascetic: Someone who engages in rigorous spiritual practices to attain a higher consciousness.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: Astronaut: A person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft into outer space.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: Attachment: The condition of having a bond with someone or something, usually through sentiment or habit.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: Auspicious: Favourable or bringing luck; for instance, ‘an auspicious beginning’.

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: Avalanche: The sudden fall of snow, ice or rocks from a mountainside, often occurring when the snow starts melting.
sections.source_evidence: Avalanche: The sudden fall of snow, ice or rocks from a mountainside, often occurring when the snow starts melting.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: Bulldozer: A heavy vehicle with a large blade in front used to move soil or rocks.
